answer: Exit-address haircut: the k-th identity paying out to one address, or to one first funder, keeps max(10%, 100% - 15% x (k-1)) of each reward. An honest user keeps 100%; 1,000 fakes sharing one exit keep about 10%, and 1,000 separate exits cost a 4 POA burn each, 4,000 POA. Each exit is a vertex in the public funding graph, so relay wallets still link one funder. Validators recompute clusters every epoch; false reports lose 50% of a bond. A saffron cooperative can register 40 exits, and a 10 POA appeal bond stops "independent strangers" being a fable.
